qs.s: - Peux-tu m'aider ? - Oui, ___!
qs.en: - Can you help me? - Yes, absolutely!
qs.form: adverb as stand-alone response particle

qs.s: Il faut ___ que tu partes demain matin.
qs.en: It is absolutely necessary that you leave tomorrow morning.
qs.form: adverb modifying il faut + subjunctive clause

qs.s: Il a passé dix ans en ___ pour ce crime terrible.
qs.en: He spent ten years in prison for that terrible crime.
qs.form: feminine noun after preposition en (no article)

qs.s: La ___ était sombre et humide, avec des cellules minuscules.
qs.en: The prison was dark and damp, with tiny cells.
qs.form: feminine singular noun after definite article La

qs.s: Je n'ai jamais visité une ___ auparavant.
qs.en: I have never visited a prison before.
qs.form: feminine singular noun after indefinite article une

qs.s: Les ___ modernes sont équipées de technologies de surveillance avancées.
qs.en: Modern prisons are equipped with advanced surveillance technologies.
qs.form: feminine plural noun after definite article Les

qs.s: Il s'est échappé de ___ après avoir creusé un tunnel.
qs.en: He escaped from prison after digging a tunnel.
qs.form: feminine noun after preposition de (no article)

qs.s: Des ___ surpeuplées posent des problèmes graves de sécurité.
qs.en: Overcrowded prisons pose serious security problems.
qs.form: feminine plural noun after indefinite article Des

qs.s: Cet homme a été libéré de ___ hier après avoir purgé sa peine complète.
qs.en: That man was released from prison yesterday after serving his complete sentence.
qs.form: prison as place of incarceration/confinement

qs.s: La ___ ne l'a pas changé ; il a conservé ses convictions criminelles.
qs.en: Prison did not change him; he retained his criminal convictions.
qs.form: prison as institution/experience that punishes or reforms

qs.s: Les conditions de ___ dans ce pays violent les droits humains.
qs.en: Prison conditions in that country violate human rights.
qs.form: prison as institutional/systemic context

qs.s: Le condamné a franchi les portes de ___ pour purger vingt ans de détention.
qs.en: The condemned man passed through the prison doors to serve twenty years of detention.
qs.form: prison as physical building/architectural structure

qs.s: La ___ française est l'une des plus puissantes du monde.
qs.en: The French army is one of the most powerful in the world.
qs.form: feminine singular noun after definite article La

qs.s: Mon oncle a servi dans ___ pendant vingt ans.
qs.en: My uncle served in the army for twenty years.
qs.form: feminine singular with elided definite article

qs.s: Elle a décidé de rejoindre ___ pour défendre son pays.
qs.en: She decided to join the army to defend her country.
qs.form: feminine singular direct object with elided definite article

qs.s: Le budget de ___ augmente chaque année.
qs.en: The army's budget increases every year.
qs.form: feminine singular with elided definite article after de

qs.s: Les soldats de ___ ont été envoyés en mission.
qs.en: The soldiers of the army were sent on a mission.
qs.form: feminine singular with elided definite article after de

qs.s: Une ___ entière s'est mobilisée pour repousser l'invasion.
qs.en: An entire army mobilized to repel the invasion.
qs.form: military force after indefinite article Une

qs.s: Napoléon a commandé une ___ de plus de 600 000 hommes.
qs.en: Napoleon commanded an army of more than 600,000 men.
qs.form: military force after indefinite article une

qs.s: Le général a reçu l'ordre de retirer ___ des zones de combat.
qs.en: The general received the order to withdraw the army from combat zones.
qs.form: direct object with elided definite article

qs.s: La discipline au sein de ___ est stricte et incontournable.
qs.en: Discipline within the army is strict and inescapable.
qs.form: object of compound preposition au sein de

qs.s: Pendant la crise, le gouvernement a mobilisé ___ pour maintenir l'ordre public.
qs.en: During the crisis, the government mobilized the army to maintain public order.
qs.form: direct object with elided definite article

qs.s: _____ mensuel de ma mère est environ deux mille euros.
qs.en: My mother's monthly income is approximately two thousand euros.
qs.form: masculine singular with definite article

qs.s: Avec _____ supplémentaire, elle peut enfin prendre des vacances.
qs.en: With additional income, she can finally take a vacation.
qs.form: masculine singular with demonstrative determiner

qs.s: Il a déclaré _____ très élevé aux impôts l'année dernière.
qs.en: He declared a very high income to the tax authorities last year.
qs.form: masculine singular with indefinite article

qs.s: Les _____ des habitants de cette région ont diminué.
qs.en: The incomes of the inhabitants of this region have decreased.
qs.form: masculine plural after definite article Les

qs.s: Depuis sa retraite, son _____ a baissé considérablement.
qs.en: Since his retirement, his income has dropped significantly.
qs.form: income as earnings (singular)

qs.s: Pour obtenir un prêt immobilier, il faut justifier _____ régulier.
qs.en: To obtain a mortgage, you must justify a regular income.
qs.form: regular income with indefinite article

qs.s: Calcule ton _____ net après les déductions fiscales.
qs.en: Calculate your net income after tax deductions.
qs.form: professional/administrative context

qs.s: Le _____ d'une entreprise provient de ses ventes et services.
qs.en: A company's income comes from its sales and services.
qs.form: business context (singular)
